data.label: Products
data.note:
The gradients of the previous frame warped by the flow so far, averaged with
the current frame's, and the products the window sums. The residual reads the warped
frame by cubic interpolation. Every pass of a level is the flow's size, its texel one over that size.

data.label: Window means
data.note:
A box of `window` pixels at the level: along x here, along y in the solve,
which reads these rows itself rather than have a pass of its own write the result.

data.label: Solve
data.note:
(Σ∇∇ᵀ) d = -Σ∇·It for the step d in pixels, y up; a window without
the texture to solve keeps the flow. Confidence is the smaller eigenvalue.
